newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty closes weaker vs basket in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty closes weaker vs basket in thin trade.

text.p: 1030 GMT - The Polish zloty closed down at 2.89/2.79 percent from the parity rate, weaker than yesterday's close at 2.97/2.87 percent after small-scale currency purchases done on the back of client orders on the shallow market, dealers said.
They said trade was thin ahead of New Year Holiday and slower activity was partly a result of the year-end changeover in accounts numbers in Polish banks coming in force from the beginning of 1997.
* It closed at 2.8740/70 to the dollar, down from 2.8710/35 on Monday and at 1.8485/05 to the mark, down from 1.8445/65.
